title: Client-Side Resolvers
description: Create client-side resolvers for computing derived local data in Apollo Client.

data.text: Just like a GraphQL server, Apollo Client can resolve fields using custom functions. Client-side resolvers let you compute derived values, transform cached data, or aggregate information from multiple cached objects without storing redundant data.

data.title: Client-side resolver

data.text: Client-side resolvers are great for computed properties like `isOverdue`, `fullName`, or `status`. They keep your cache lean while providing rich derived data to components.
data.title: Computed Fields
Client-Side Resolvers Key Points
points: Resolvers compute derived data on the client.
Use readField to access other cached fields.
Keep cache lean by computing instead of storing.
Resolvers participate in the reactive cache system.
data.takeaway: Client-side resolvers turn Apollo Client into a lightweight reactive data engine.
